articles.summary: LITTLE ROCK, Ark., March 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Dillard’s, Inc. (“Dillard’s”) (NYSE: DDS) is pleased to introduce Amanda Jones Vaughan x Antonio Melani. This highly anticipated, exclusive style collaboration is available now in Dillard’s stores nationwide as well as online at dillards.com.
articles.title: Dillard’s Introduces Amanda Jones Vaughan x Antonio Melani
